answer: Agents cannot wander in freely: each enters through one narrow inlet, vouched for by two established agents who each lock 20 tokens. The vouch lasts five epochs; the newcomer must finish one verified paid job inside it, or the stake stays frozen five more epochs. If the newcomer commits fraud, both sponsors lose their tokens and cannot vouch for ten epochs, and each sponsor backs at most three per epoch. A 1,000-clone farm needs about 667 sponsors, while one honest agent needs just two friends. Trust is a jade seal: hard to earn, easy to check, and a forgery shatters when pressed.
